faq.ans: Digital marketing encompasses various online strategies and channels to promote products or services. It refers to the strategic use of digital channels and platforms to reach and engage with a target audience.

faq.ques: What are the 5 major types of digital marketing?
faq.ans: The five major types of digital marketing are search engine optimization (SEO), social media marketing, pay-per-click advertising (PPC), content marketing, and email marketing.

Digital marketing matters because it allows businesses to reach a wider audience, target specific demographics, measure and analyze campaign performance, build brand credibility, and drive customer engagement and conversions in the digital age.

faq.ques: What are the four keys of digital marketing?
faq.ans: The four keys of digital marketing are the target audience, compelling content, multi-channel presence, data analysis, and optimization.
Digital marketing works by utilizing various online channels and tactics to reach and engage with a target audience.
